He is shocked to find an unfamiliar face staring back at him in the mirror, but when he looks again, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)
chapterSourceTitle: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru

title: Welcome to Undead Park
titleNative: 웰컴 투 언데드파크
synopsis: The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive - from the zombies, and from them. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)
